_comment: Competition rules and model settings. Edit freely.

model._thrust_cal_extrapolation_options: thrust calibration factor above the highest-rpm bench point: hold = keep the last bench factor; linear = extend the slope of the last two bench points (floor 0.5); flat = mean of the group's bench factors at every rpm
model._current_limit_mode_options: cap = assume an ESC current limit at the lowest rating (motor, ESC, battery); reject = drop combos that exceed a rating; ignore = no limits

ranking_without_plane._metric_options: avg_thrust (mean thrust 0..avg_up_to_mps), static_thrust, net_thrust (avg_thrust minus propulsion mass), thrust_per_watt
